plans.title: Fyra spår Uppsala, utformning av planförslaget (Figur 9: översikt stationsområdet)

open: Heights of L0 and L-1: no source measures them.

Signposted level names in the station building: Jernhusen only says the toilets are on 'övre plan'; no plan names the floors. OSM puts Caffè Nero, Sushi Yama, Espresso House and UL Center on level 1 and DOZ, Pressbyrån, Subway on level 0, which does not match the app's L0/L-1 scheme; which shop is on which floor stays unconfirmed.

Exact position of the Centralpassagen lifts/stairs to islands 2/3 and 4/7: Trafikverket says every track has a lift from Centralpassagen, but OSM maps none for these two islands and no readable plan shows them.
Toilet fee amount: Jernhusen says card only, no price (the app's 10 SEK has no source here).

Hours for Gateau and Pressbyrån from their own sites (pages load dynamically). Stationen restaurant (old station building): stationen.se blocks fetching; OSM's hours string is not valid opening_hours syntax.
UL's station-area maps could only be read as text; the positions of ticket machines, taxi and the stops are not in the text.

answers.question: platform 2: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own (reached along the platform level only)
answers.answer: Wrong in the app: island platform 2/3 has a way up from Centralpassagen (Trafikverket: Centralpassagen is the 'uppgång/nedgång för spår 2 till 7' and has a lift to every track) and stairs + lift at the south end from Strandbodgatan (OSM w207791563, w207791539; Trafikverket confirms four lifts at Strandbodgatan). OSM is missing the Centralpassagen stair/lift for 2/3.
